artifacts.summary: Verdict research: Presented is refuted as a completeness carrier by a compiled pumping probe (model A, every finite presentation); the per-seam stab check under Presented is run-level and compiled; Decidable (PlusValidZTime phi) is unreachable from the landed substrate and the three missing theorems (C), (S), (W) are named; plan-ready phases and file_scope.

Compiled (lake env lean, 0 sorries, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]): Probe735.not_presented, for every finite Q/lab/step, not Presented MA stayA t Fp lab step, by pumping a repeated state against LocalRun.untl.
Compiled (same axiom set): Probe735b.plusStab_iff_forall_run_of_presented, the stab check under Presented as a run-level condition with no k-type evaluation.

verdict_summary: Decidable (PlusValidZTime phi) is not reachable from the ray-product presentation: Presented is unsatisfiable on fixture model A for every finite presentation (compiled theorem), so no Presented-enumeration can be complete; the lift additionally needs Hit-level completeness with a computable bound (C), Hit-level soundness (S, the unfiled B2b successor restated), and a closure-wide quasimodel (W), none in the tree. The per-seam check Decidable (PlusTruthAt M tau t (.stab phi)) under Presented, stated in the theorem, is the positive deliverable.

memory_candidates.title: Per-state-labelled finite presentations present only pumping-closed trace sets; untl letters make seam trace sets non-closed
memory_candidates.content: A finite presentation (Q, lab, step) with runs IsRun (per-coordinate step + now anchor) has a run set closed under repeating any loop strictly after the anchor (pump via a Nat-recursive loopIdx, no modular arithmetic). The closure-trace map sigma -> clTrace is discontinuous in untl/snce letters, so a seam's trace set on even a finite regular slice need not be closed; exact trace-set equality (Presented) is therefore a soundness device and never a completeness carrier. Probe: specs/735_.../probes/presented-not-complete.lean.

memory_candidates.title: Under a two-directional trace-set hypothesis the stab bridge is run-level; the family/k-type machinery factors out
memory_candidates.content: Given Presented M tau t phi lab step, PlusTruthAt M tau t (.stab phi) iff every anchored run rho has lab (rho t) (clPhi phi) = true (plusStab_iff_omega + both directions of Presented + definitional clTrace/runTrace). The per-triple InFamily condition is only needed under the weaker HitCl = hitOf hypothesis, where PathEntry.rep supplies the representative.

memory_candidates.title: Anonymous constructor for a def-wrapped subtype (StabFibre) elaborates against the bare subtype inside Equiv applications
memory_candidates.content: seamOmegaEquiv t s ⟨σ, h⟩ with ⟨σ, h⟩ elaborated inline produced an application type mismatch ({σ // ...} vs Presheaf.StabFibre ...) and Equiv.symm_apply_apply failed to rewrite. Fix: let x : Presheaf.StabFibre F t s := ⟨σ, h⟩, then have hrt := Equiv.symm_apply_apply e x and rw [hrt] after a show that exposes e.symm (e x).
